metadata.title: Tribal issues in Gujarat Election  | गुजरात मतदान का पहला चरण और आदिवासी नेतृत्व का संकट
metadata.description: The voting for first phase of assembly elections in Gujarat will happen on 1 December. In this phase 14 constituencies reserved for tribal Population will also go for poll. We try to find out if the issues of tribals were discussed in the campaign for this phase of election.
